inventory_scope: Reviewed official sources concerning Liechtenstein residence and free movement, related procedure and remedies, and official operational guidance. EEA, Swiss, and third-country legal routes remain distinct.

entries.title: Gesetze.li official consolidated-law database and version guidance

entries.scope: Official discovery/navigation page for consolidated Liechtenstein national and treaty law, including historical-date search and stable-link pattern.

entries.title: EWR-Register of applicable EEA legal acts
entries.publisher: EEA Coordination Unit, Liechtenstein National Administration
entries.version: Official page checked 2026-10-25; the EWR-Register and EU-programme register current issues are dated 25 September 2026.
entries.scope: Official index/navigation reference listing EEA-law titles and Official Journal references associated with Joint Committee decisions published in the Liechtenstein Gazette; a specific act still requires source-specific incorporation and effective-date verification.
limitations: Link-only reference; no local register PDF accepted.
The register is not itself the promulgating instrument and does not establish current legal force or applicability of each listed act.
The prior candidate route was recorded as HTTP 403; this current LLV route was checked as its official replacement.
LR 170.51 and EWR-RegV LR 170.511 are distinct legal instruments.

entries.title: EEA Joint Committee Decision No 191/1999 on Liechtenstein's free-movement solution
entries.version: Decision dated 17 December 1999; national publication LR 0.110.032.77 / LGBl 2000.097. Article 3 states entry into force from 1 January 2000 subject to the Article 103(1) notification condition.
entries.scope: Official EFTA-hosted treaty decision amending EEA Agreement Annexes V and VIII and recording a Liechtenstein-specific arrangement. This historical instrument is not a complete statement of current national residence law or individual entitlement.

entries.title: Gesetz über die Umsetzung und Kundmachung der EWR-Rechtsvorschriften, LR 170.51
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex current-text frame version 2; official PDF Fassung 01.02.2021; LGBl 2020.358 effective 1 February 2021; 2026 Systematisches Register (stand 1 October) lists 2020.358 as the latest amendment.
entries.scope: Primary law governing implementation and promulgation of EEA rules; Art. 4 ties applicability to the EEA Agreement and Joint Committee decisions published in the Liechtenstein Gazette, and Art. 5 provides for a register. The separately identified EWR-RegV LR 170.511 is not included.
limitations: Lilex consolidation is informational and has no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
The official register is current through 1 October 2026; later changes are not excluded.
EWR-RegV LR 170.511 is separate and not included in this file.
The law does not establish act-specific EEA incorporation, adaptations or current force without further review.
Source acceptance is separate from immigration topic coverage and country completion.

entries.title: Personenfreizügigkeitsgesetz (PFZG), LR 152.21
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex current-text frame version 11; consolidation as of 1 January 2026; latest listed amendment LGBl 2025.397, effective 1 January 2026
entries.scope: Primary law governing entry, residence and family reunification for EEA/Swiss nationals and specified family/other-beneficiary categories, with a Liechtenstein-specific EEA solution and quota structure.
limitations: Lilex says consolidated laws are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.
Dependencies and treaty bases require separate review; no legal equivalence with other EEA or EU national regimes is implied.

entries.title: Personenfreizügigkeitsverordnung (PFZV), LR 152.211
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 15; consolidation 1 January 2024; latest listed amendments LGBl 2023.458 and 2023.464, both effective 1 January 2024
entries.scope: Implementing regulation under PFZG concerning entry, residence, permits, evidence, family reunification, and related procedure for the EEA/Swiss free-movement framework in Liechtenstein.
limitations: Lilex says consolidated laws and regulations are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
PFZV implements PFZG; EEA instruments, the special Liechtenstein EEA solution, and the Swiss framework remain separate dependencies.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.
Raw response files were unavailable for offline replay in the current checkout; official HTML/PDF anchors were checked and the limitation is recorded.

entries.title: Ausländergesetz (AuG), LR 152.20
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 25; consolidation dated 12 June 2026; latest listed amendment LGBl 2026.143, effective 12 June 2026
entries.scope: Entry, residence, family reunification, integration, and related procedure for persons within AuG Art. 2, principally third-country nationals and family members of persons within that scope; EEA/Swiss routes remain distinct.
limitations: Lilex consolidated laws are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
AuG Art. 2 sets personal-scope limits and excludes the PFZG free-movement route.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.
Current procedure, forms, and related legal dependencies require separate review.

entries.title: Verordnung über die Zulassung und den Aufenthalt von Ausländern (ZAV), LR 152.201
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex current-text frame version 17; latest listed amendment LGBl 2026.193, effective 12 June 2026
entries.scope: Implementing regulation under AuG covering detailed admission, residence, permits, family reunification, screening and related procedure, including specific cross-border-service rules; the PFZG EEA/Swiss residence route remains distinct.
limitations: Lilex consolidations are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
The version reviewed includes LGBl 2026.193 effective 12 June 2026; later applicability is not established.
ZAV supplements the AuG third-country route and is not the PFZG EEA/Swiss regime.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.

entries.title: Verordnung über die Einreise und die Visumerteilung (VEV), LR 152.204
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 2; official PDF Fassung 12.10.2025; LGBl 2025.483 effective 12 October 2025; 2026 Systematisches Register stand 1 October lists LGBl 2025.483 as latest VEV amendment
entries.scope: Regulates entry into Liechtenstein and visa issuance, including short- and long-stay conditions, procedures, competent authorities, cooperation, refusal and remedies; applicable Schengen rules prevail where they differ, and Swiss/other representation agreements apply. Not a complete statement of Schengen law or current mission practice.
limitations: Lilex consolidated text is informational and has no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
The official system register is current to 1 October 2026; it does not exclude a later VEV change.
Schengen acquis, the Visa Code, Schengen Borders Code, VISV/EESV, AuG/PFZG, Swiss agreements, visa-fee rules and operational mission guidance require separate review.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country completion.

entries.title: Protocol regarding free movement of persons between Switzerland and Liechtenstein
entries.version: Protocol under the amended EFTA Convention, Annex K. EFTA-hosted PDF copy retrieved 2026-10-19; date of signature and present legal status were not independently established in this review.
entries.scope: Official EFTA-hosted protocol text on movement between Switzerland and Liechtenstein. It is a distinct bilateral/EFTA source and must not be treated as the EEA free-movement route or as a legal-equivalence finding.

entries.title: Landesverwaltungspflegegesetz (LVG)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 30 captured 2026-10-19 for LGBl 1922.024 / LR 172.020; the captured text includes amendment notes through LGBl 2025 Nr. 375. No separate date of consolidation was displayed in the candidate record.
entries.scope: General Liechtenstein administrative procedure and appeals statute; use the official dated Gazette publication for legally material dates and verify cross-references to the applicable procedure.

entries.title: Informationsgesetz (Information Act)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 8 captured 2026-10-19 for LGBl 1999.159 / LR 172.015; the text records amendment LGBl 2025 Nr. 32, effective 1 January 2026.
entries.scope: Liechtenstein statutory source on public information. It is separate from the Informationsweiterverwendungsgesetz (IWG), which governs reuse of public-sector information.

entries.title: Informationsweiterverwendungsgesetz (IWG)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 1 for LGBl 2024.041 / LR 172.016, captured 2026-10-19. The text states entry into force on 1 August 2026 under LGBl 2026 Nr. 249.
entries.scope: Liechtenstein legislation on open data and reuse of public-sector information. It is not an access-to-information statute and does not establish a complete public dataset inventory.
